forecasts.label: rules-based platform forecast

rule.words: the least-squares line through the last 14 days of weigh-ins, read on the target day

forecasts.claim: Weight will be about 281.7 lb on 2026-11-23.
forecasts.evaluation_rule: Graded on the reading on 2026-11-23: confirmed if it is closer to 281.7 (the forecast) than to 285.9 (a guess that nothing changes: the reading of 2026-11-15, the last before the forecast was made); refuted if the guess is as close or closer; inconclusive with no reading.

scoring.words: right when the forecast lands closer to the reading on the target day than a guess that nothing changes (the last reading before the forecast was made); a tie counts for the guess
